title: R2X and R4 residence districts (ZR 23-21 rows 2-3) - maximum residential floor area ratio (standard zoning lots)
description: DRAFT extraction (needs_review) of the maximum residential floor area ratio for standard zoning lots in the R2X and R4 rows of the ZR 23-21 table: R2X (standard 1.00, qualifying 1.00) and R4A, R4B, R4, R4-1 (standard 1.00, qualifying 1.50). NOT a Verified determination - a candidate representation awaiting raw-HTML source verification and G6 qualified-human legal approval. The engine computes the standard-zoning-lot FAR (1.00 for every district here) and the resulting maximum residential floor area from the lot area; the higher qualifying-residential-sites FAR is surfaced as a conditional alternative (never silently applied). The ZR 23-21 footnote-1 0.60 single-dwelling-unit equivalent-FAR cap does NOT apply to these rows (the byte-verified recapture, commit 17e8eb78, proved it is scoped to the first table row's standard value only) and is deliberately absent here. effective_from is the section's Last Amended date (2024-12-05): evaluating as_of an earlier date yields a visible not-effective outcome.

citations.quote: MAXIMUM FLOOR AREA RATIO FOR R1-R5 DISTRICTS. R2X | Standard zoning lots 1.00 | Qualifying residential sites 1.00. R4A, R4B, R4, R4-1 | Standard zoning lots 1.00 | Qualifying residential sites 1.50

inputs.name: zoning_district
inputs.description: The residence district governing the lot (or the portion under evaluation). District SCOPE is enforced by applicability (in_set R2X/R4A/R4B/R4/R4-1), NOT by an input domain enum: a district outside this set is a visible not_applicable. An uncertain M2-T013 geometric assignment is passed via spatial_context and downgrades coverage.

inputs.name: lot_area_sq_ft
inputs.description: Zoning-lot area in square feet; must be strictly positive. A zero/negative/non-finite value is rejected fail-closed (professional_review_required, no computed value).

inputs.name: site_class
inputs.description: Whether the lot is a standard zoning lot or a 'qualifying residential site'. When absent, the qualifying-site alternative is surfaced as conditional (not decided).

outputs.name: max_residential_far
outputs.description: Maximum residential floor area ratio for a standard zoning lot in the district (ZR 23-21 standard value 1.00 for these rows).

outputs.name: max_residential_floor_area_sq_ft
outputs.description: Maximum residential floor area = lot area x FAR.

parameters.name: standard_far_by_district
parameters.note: Standard-zoning-lot maximum residential FAR (1.00) for R2X and every R4 variant per the ZR 23-21 table. Candidate values pending raw-HTML verification and G6 approval.

parameters.name: qualifying_far_by_district
parameters.note: Qualifying-residential-sites maximum residential FAR: 1.00 for R2X and 1.50 for R4A/R4B/R4/R4-1 per the ZR 23-21 table. SURFACED as the conditional alternative (see the qualifying_residential_site exception), never applied by this rule: whether a lot is a qualifying residential site is a separate legal determination. Provenance-linked here so the value is byte-checkable against the snapshot; deliberately not consumed by a computation step.

steps.note: Select the standard-zoning-lot maximum residential FAR for the district (ZR 23-21 = 1.00 for these rows).
Maximum residential floor area = lot area (sq ft) x FAR.

exceptions.description: A higher maximum residential floor area ratio for zoning lots that are 'qualifying residential sites' per ZR 23-21: 1.00 for R2X and 1.50 for R4A, R4B, R4 and R4-1. Whether a specific lot qualifies is a separate legal determination and is not decided by this rule; when the site class is unknown or qualifying, the result is conditional and the higher FAR may apply.
exceptions.note: Surfaced, never collapsed: the standard-lot FAR is reported with an explicit conditional flag that a qualifying-site FAR (1.00 for R2X, 1.50 for the R4 variants) may govern.

special_district_interactions.description: Special Purpose Districts (ZR Articles VIII-XIV) and other mapped overlays may modify residence-district floor area. When a mapped special district applies, its provisions govern and must be evaluated by the corresponding special rule; this general rule does not apply the modification.

uncertainty_policy.note: An uncertain, split, sliver, or invalid M2-T013 geometric district assignment is never collapsed into a single definitive district: coverage is downgraded to professional_review_required (or data_conflict) and the geometric uncertainty is recorded in the trace.

limitations: Draft extraction pending raw-HTML source verification and G6 qualified-human legal approval; not a Verified determination.
Only the standard-zoning-lot residential FAR is computed; the qualifying-residential-site FAR (1.00 for R2X, 1.50 for the R4 variants) is surfaced (conditional), not computed.
The ZR 23-21 footnote-1 0.60 single-dwelling-unit equivalent-FAR cap does not apply to these rows and is intentionally absent.
Special Purpose District and other overlay modifications are not applied.
